title: Using rocks
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:22Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point, How rocks are used, covers how formation sets properties and how rocks are matched to jobs, but it does not teach mining, which the new point requires, so adding that idea would be more than a small change.

draft.title: Using rocks
card: A rock's properties come from how it formed. Hardness is how well it resists scratching. Strength is how well it resists being crushed or broken. Look is its colour, grain and pattern.
People choose a rock for a job by matching its properties to the need. Granite is hard, strong and often speckled, so it is used for kitchen benches and building steps.

Marble is a metamorphic rock that is softer than granite and easy to carve. Its look is prized, so it is used for statues and decorative floors. Sandstone is a sedimentary rock that is easy to cut into blocks, so it is used for walls and paving.
How a rock formed also affects how it is mined. Soft rock near the surface can be dug from an open pit. Hard rock can need blasting or heavy cutting machines.
draft.remember: A rock's properties come from how it formed, and they decide what it is used for and how it is mined.

a.q: Why is granite a good choice for a kitchen bench?
opts: It is hard and strong, so it resists scratches and knocks
It is soft and easy to carve, so it can be shaped
It forms in layers, so it splits into thin slabs
It holds fossils, so each bench has its own pattern
a.why: Granite is hard and strong, so a bench made from it resists scratching and damage. Being easy to carve is a property of softer rocks such as marble, so it is not the reason granite is chosen.
a.clue: Think about what a bench has to put up with every day.

b.q: A council wants a rock for a statue that must be carved into fine detail. Which rock suits the job best?
opts: Marble, because it is softer and easy to carve
Granite, because it is the hardest and strongest
Granite, because it forms from cooled molten rock
Marble, because it is harder than most other rocks
b.why: Fine carving needs a rock that is easy to cut, and marble is softer than granite. Granite is tempting because it is hard and strong, but that makes it difficult to carve into detail.
b.clue: A rock that is very hard is also hard to shape.

a.best: It is hard and strong, so it resists scratches and knocks

b.best: Marble, because it is softer and easy to carve
